[Subscribe](#subscribe) ::: ::: {.owd-screens} ::: {.owd-screen} ::: {.owd-screen-inner} ::: {.owd-screen-text} 01 Why ## Open data for water, sanitation and hygiene

openwashdata is a community that publishes WASH datasets as documented, citable R data packages, and teaches the skills to do it.

::: {#subscribe}
::: ::: ::: {.owd-screen-visual} ::: {.owd-numbers} ::: {.owd-number-item}
50
published data packages
::: ::: {.owd-number-item}
11
countries and regions
::: ::: {.owd-number-item}
2023
first package published
::: ::: ::: ::: ::: ::: {.owd-screen} ::: {.owd-screen-inner} ::: {.owd-screen-text} 02 Data ## 50 datasets, one workflow

Every dataset is an R data package with a website, a data dictionary, a license and a citation. The newest: [mwgroundwaterdata](), [mwefloodresponse](), [waterpointfunctionality]().

::: {.owd-actions} [Browse the datasets](pages/gallery/data/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} ::: ::: ::: {.owd-screen-visual} ::: {.owd-chart}

Data packages published per year

```{ojs} rawc = FileAttachment("pages/gallery/data/data_data/tbl-01-openwashdata-datasets.csv").csv({typed: false}) yearsc = rawc .filter(d => d.status === "published" && d.date_published && d.date_published !== "NA") .map(d => ({year: d.date_published.slice(0, 4)})) Plot.plot({ width: Math.min(width, 520), height: 240, marginLeft: 30, marginTop: 24, style: {fontFamily: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, sans-serif", fontSize: 13, background: "transparent"}, x: {label: null, tickSize: 0, type: "band"}, y: {label: null, grid: true, ticks: 4}, marks: [ Plot.barY(yearsc, Plot.groupX({y: "count"}, {x: "year", fill: "#5b195b", tip: true})), Plot.text(yearsc, Plot.groupX({y: "count", text: "count"}, {x: "year", dy: -8, fill: "#1e1e1e", fontWeight: 700})), Plot.ruleY([0]) ] }) ``` ::: ::: ::: ::: ::: {.owd-screen} ::: {.owd-screen-inner} ::: {.owd-screen-text} 03 Learn ## Data science in R, for WASH professionals

ds4owd is our free online course. Two cohorts have graduated so far, and the community meets at events through the year.

::: {.owd-actions} [See the course](pages/academy/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [All events](pages/events/index.qmd){.btn .btn-outline} ::: ::: ::: {.owd-screen-visual} ### Recent events ::: {#next-events} ::: ::: ::: ::: ::: {.owd-screen} ::: {.owd-screen-inner} ::: {.owd-screen-text} 04 Read ## Stories from the community

Opinions, tutorials and lessons learned by the people who publish and use the data.

::: {.owd-actions} [Read the blog](pages/blog/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} ::: ::: ::: {.owd-screen-visual} ::: {#latest-post} ::: ::: ::: ::: ::: {.owd-screen} ::: {.owd-screen-inner} ::: {.owd-screen-text} 05 Join ## Bring your data, your questions, or your time

The community is open. Talk to us on Matrix, publish a dataset with us, or contribute on GitHub.
